resources.string: Use two accounts on the same app.
DualSpace stays offline, your apps don\'t
Create Space 2, an isolated profile managed by Android.
Choose the apps you want to duplicate.
Sign in to your other account in each copy.
Space 2 is paused. Turn it back on with the Work apps quick setting, then come back here.
Another work profile already exists on this phone, and Android only allows one. Remove it in the phone settings to use DualSpace.
This phone refuses to create a work profile.
Work profiles are not supported on this phone.
A copy with its own data will be added to Space 2. Android will ask you to confirm, and you will need to sign in to the copy.
To install copies, allow DualSpace once on the Android screen, then come back here.
Preparing Space 2. Come back and try again.
All copies and their data will be permanently deleted. Your original apps are not affected.

DualSpace has no Internet permission and contains no ads or analytics, so the app itself cannot send anything online.

It reads your list of apps only on this phone, to offer them for duplication.

Each copy keeps its own Internet access. Instagram, Snapchat and other apps keep sending data to their own services, just like the originals.

Space 2 data is kept separate from your main profile. Some apps, especially banking apps, may refuse to run in a work profile.
